snippet.title: SOULMASK 1st Anniversary! FREE DLC + Automation Update!
snippet.description:
Hey Chiefs! Get ready for the Soulmask 1st Anniversary Celebration with an EPIC update launching June 5th! 🎉
Don't miss out on a 30% OFF historical low discount! Now's the perfect time to jump in! 👇
🎁 FREE GOLDEN LEGEND DLC!
Unleash the power of the new Golden Legend Mask, a mysterious artifact from the ancient East! This game-changing mask offers unparalleled insight for recruiting and PvP, making you the ultimate tribal leader! Plus, get exclusive Sacred Bronze Tree and Mysterious Bronze Man to enhance your tribe's aesthetic! ✨
⚙️ AUTOMATION ERA! Say Goodbye to the Grind!
Revolutionize your base with new automation tech! The Power Ropeway, Power Mine, Planning Mode, and Weapon/Gear Racks will free your hands and supercharge your efficiency. Build your dream base effortlessly and become the ultimate base-building master! 🏗️
Launch Date: June 5th!
🔗 Get Soulmask on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460/Soulmask/
💬 Join our Tribe on Discord: discord.gg/eVsURRrKU3
